ref: ADR-0006 Consequences, SUPPRESS through the context functions since #51 (assumed): sort orders a SUPPRESS value as the smallest, first ascending; the SUPPRESS comes from createIf, true for 1 or true and SUPPRESS for 0 or false, in any case, and anything else ends the run with po:CREATEIF (ADR-0006 amended, F-37; fn/createIf/002); observation #61
note: createIf over Tag in context Orders gives "", SUPPRESS, "", SUPPRESS. Ascending puts SUPPRESS first: SUPPRESS, SUPPRESS, "", "". formatByExample cuts after three slots, as Sku in context Order does, so the first context holds one "": one empty All. Unsorted or SUPPRESS last gives two.
